propositions: Plan-review attestations must distinguish planning (stricter review) from execution (0.80 blocking floor) phases, tracked separately in compiled state and signed manifest records.

The plan_review_phase reducer projection is set by winning STATUS targets (in_progress→execution, open→planning, others preserve) and persisted through snapshot compaction with bootstrap from legacy snapshots.

Manifest grammar requires review-phase token in fixed position, execution phase mandates priority-floor: 0.80, and all phase/floor syntax is validated through a single helper with malformed and incompatible distinction.

Phase compatibility is enforced across all validity consumers (claim, reuse, drift refresh, re-sign, completion) by comparing current compiled phase to signed phase, allowing execution only with floor ≥ 0.80.

Plan-review signing is protected by an immutable generation transaction capturing phase, priority floor, material, relations, and tracker revision; stable generation signs atomically under lock with at-most-three retries for HEAD instability and terminal abort on stale generation or signing failure.

Rollback requires pausing compact and re-sign during downgrade; old-reducer snapshot replay preserves unknown phase field, and forward upgrade reboots it from compiled status with documented precision loss during the downgrade window.
